highlights: Major AI developers are aggressively cutting model costs while simultaneously boosting performance and introducing new models, democratizing access to frontier intelligence for builders.

Significant progress in AI agents focuses on enhancing consistency, efficiency through token/cost reduction, and improving sophisticated reasoning capabilities for social interactions and enterprise data comprehension.
New open-source tools and specialized models are emerging, empowering developers with advanced features for multi-modal embeddings, rapid agent action scoring, and real-time audio diarization.

agents.title: Agents More Consistent: Skills Should Form Habits for Repeat Tasks
agents.summary: This research introduces skill habit formation for agents, drastically improving consistency for repeat tasks, reducing token usage by 14-56%, and providing auditable execution traces.

agents.title: Contrastive-LM Releases CLM-8B: Open System One Model Scores Agent Actions Up to 9× Faster Than Jev
agents.summary: Contrastive-LM launched CLM-8B, an open System One model that scores candidate agent actions up to 9x faster than TypeSafe's Jev, significantly improving efficiency for deep reasoning tasks.

agents.title: ReAdapt for Relational Social Reasoning: When LLM Agents Fail to Read the Room
agents.summary: ReAdapt enhances LLM agents' relational social reasoning by integrating an explicit structured social state into the ReAct loop, improving decision-making in complex social contexts by revising initial hypotheses.

models.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Opus 5.5: Fable 5.1-Level Performance at 40% Lower Running Cost Than Opus 5
models.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, a new model achieving Fable 5.1-level performance with 40% lower running costs than Opus 5, notably leading in agentic coding benchmarks.

models.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
models.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two new models offering frontier intelligence with varied capability and cost balances, making advanced AI more accessible for everyday applications.

models.title: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS With Prompt-Based Voice Design
models.summary: Google launched Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS, new text-to-speech models offering prompt-based voice design across 100+ languages and a cost-effective lite version for high-volume applications.

tools.title: Nokia Open-Sources AnyJev: A Training-Free Layer That Turns Any Open LLM Into a Calibrated Decision Model
tools.summary: Nokia open-sourced AnyJev, a training-free Python library that converts any open LLM into a calibrated decision model for fixed-set answer selection, easily deployable via PyPI.

tools.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
tools.summary: GPT-6 now features improved prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, and explicit controls, significantly reducing latency and costs for developers using the API.

tools.title: Transformers now runs llama.cpp quants
tools.summary: The Hugging Face Transformers library now supports `llama.cpp` quantizations, enabling developers to run highly efficient quantized LLMs directly within the framework for optimized inference.

companies.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-6 Sol and Luna: 50% Cheaper API Pricing and Benchmarks
companies.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Sol and Luna models with up to 50% cheaper API pricing than GPT-6 Astra, coupled with improved prompt caching for long-running agents.

companies.title: Harvey turns legal context into stronger drafts with GPT-6 Astra
companies.summary: Harvey is leveraging OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to produce more structured and context-aware legal documents, empowering lawyers to focus on strategy by automating complex drafting tasks.

companies.title: Airbnb widens access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models
companies.summary: Airbnb is expanding access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI's frontier models for its engineering teams, aiming to accelerate bug resolution, system design, and overall product shipping speed.

learning.title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
learning.summary: OpenAI and Grab launched 'GO Forward with AI,' a regional program to equip 30,000 partners across Southeast Asia with practical AI skills, fostering broader AI adoption and capability development.

learning.title: DevFest is back
learning.summary: DevFest 2026 is returning with over 800 global events, offering developers opportunities to build, secure, and scale solutions effectively in the agentic AI era.

learning.title: A Coding Guide to TypeSafe AI Jev: Typed Decisions, Calibrated Confidence, and Speculative Fan-Out with a System One Model
learning.summary: This tutorial provides a complete coding guide to TypeSafe AI's Jev, a System One model, covering its Python SDK, primitive question types, speculative fan-out, and production workflow implementation.
